title: 106 years: remembering Dattopant Thengadi, and the hundredth post
author: Editorial Desk
summary: Born 10 November 1920. A closing reflection for the first hundred Sundays.
body:
*Photo: Dattopant Thengadi (1920–2004)*

Five days ago, on **10 November**, India marked **106 years** since the birth of **Dattopant Thengadi**. This is also the hundredth post in this series.

## What these hundred Sundays covered

- **Law:** the four Labour Codes, wages, social security, safety and contracts.
- **The world:** the ILO, platform work standards, BRICS and international forums.
- **Workers left out:** scheme workers, gig workers, domestic and migrant workers.
- **Federations:** from railways and defence to beedi and fisheries.
- **Ideas:** *Rashtra hit, Udyog hit, Mazdoor hit*, labourisation, Swadeshi, Samarasata.
- **People:** Thengadi Ji, Ambedkar, Gandhi, the new national team.

## What he would want

A boy from Arvi who became an organiser would ask only that we continue the work. Teach workers. Serve the nation. Remain simple.

## What next

This blog will continue, with a new article every Sunday at 7:00 am. Karyakartas can also post through the admin panel, using the **Write** page. Suggestions for topics are welcome.

Thank you for reading.
